description: Project-wide QA posture snapshot: releases (version, lifecycleStatus, due date, passed / failed / blocked / not-attempted counts), issues (active, inProgress, blocked, openBySeverity), activeTestRuns with result counts, and testsAwaitingVerificationCount.
